question.text: The number of valence electrons present in the metal among $\mathrm{Cr}, \mathrm{Co}, \mathrm{Fe}$ and Ni which has the lowest enthalpy of atomisation is

solution.text:
Out of $\mathrm{Cr}, \mathrm{Co}, \mathrm{Fe}$ and $\mathrm{Ni}$
Chromium has lowest heat of atomisation.
$\mathrm{Cr}=[\mathrm{Ar}] 3 \mathrm{~d}^5 4 \mathrm{~s}^1$
$\because$ Total six valence $\mathrm{e}^{-}$in $\mathrm{Cr}$.
